svg.aria-label: Design tokens pipeline: brand token files exported from Figma variables are uploaded to tokens/ in the GitHub repo. GitHub Actions runs Style Dictionary (build, test, compare) and publishes skoda.css with CSS variables, frontend-token-definition.json for Liferay Style Books, and the @bertpv/design-tokens package to npm and GitHub Releases.
